title: Written communication of control deficiencies — Ruiz Plumbing Supply
instructions: Review the draft AU-C 265 communication for **Ruiz Plumbing Supply** (nonissuer) and correct the highlighted wording.

parts.prompt: Select the correct wording for each highlighted phrase.

segments.explanation: Significant deficiencies and material weaknesses are communicated in writing to those charged with governance.

segments.text: In planning and performing our audit, we considered internal control as a basis for designing audit procedures,

segments.original: and to express an opinion on its effectiveness
options: and to express an opinion on its effectiveness
but not to express an opinion on its effectiveness
segments.answer: but not to express an opinion on its effectiveness
segments.explanation: A financial statement audit doesn't express an opinion on internal control.

segments.text:
.

We identified a deficiency we consider a material weakness: no one reviews vendor master file changes.

segments.original: We noted no other deficiencies in internal control.
options: We noted no other deficiencies in internal control.
Our consideration was not designed to identify all deficiencies.
segments.answer: Our consideration was not designed to identify all deficiencies.
segments.explanation: The auditor may not state that no other deficiencies exist.

segments.original: within 90 days after the report release date
options: within 90 days after the report release date
no later than 60 days after the report release date
segments.answer: no later than 60 days after the report release date
segments.explanation: AU-C 265 requires the written communication by the documentation completion date (60 days).
